panels.title: One tap, and you talk.
panels.text: It keeps recording with the phone locked.

panels.title: Your meeting turns into minutes.
panels.text: Key points, decisions and actions, each with its timestamp.

panels.title: You never file anything again.
panels.text: Title, tags and theme arrive on their own while you move on.

panels.title: Ask, and it comes back.
panels.text: “What was that pricing idea?” The answer cites its notes.
